Keep a personal book-log diary (alongside the citation logs). Ask the class & librarian for recommendations. Use the library MetaSearch function when out of ideas.

-> Manage the relationship between educational research and ‘job’ research
> Can I have a work-life balance between professional and educational requirements?
> Continue doing sports, learning languages, and reading outside of academia.
Implement better use of personal calendar. Fill in 'softer' things like personal relaxing time, and time with friends (& cats). Write a "priority list" so that if I get too busy on a particular period, I know what is safe to temporarily pause/drop from my schedule.
